008package release.support;

010import java.io.IOException;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.nio.file.*;

017/**
018 * Provides support for Maven-related operations during the release process.
019 */
020public final class MavenSupport {
021    private MavenSupport() {
022    }
023
024    /**
025     * The profiles whose modules are not in the normal build: the installers (packaging) and the
026     * old installers kept as a backup (old-installers). The version commands activate them, so
027     * the versions of those modules move along with the rest.
028     */
029    static final String VERSION_PROFILES = "-Ppackaging,old-installers";
030
031    /**
032     * Installs the given modules into the local repository together with every project module
033     * they depend on (the parent POM, paint-shared-utils, paint-ui-common, ...).
034     * <p>
035     * The modules are later built one by one from their own folder, which only works if what
036     * they depend on is already installed. Maven works out that list itself ({@code -am}), so a
037     * new library module does not have to be added here by hand.
038     */
039    public static void installModulesAndDependencies(List<String> modules) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
040        List<String> cmd = installModulesAndDependenciesCommand(modules);
041        System.out.println("\n🧱 Installing the modules and everything they depend on...");
042        System.out.println("🔧 Running: " + String.join(" ", cmd));
043
044        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
045        pb.directory(PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.toFile());
046        Process process = ProcessRunner.startAndFilterOutput(pb, "dependencies");
047        int exit = process.waitFor();
048        if (exit != 0) {
049            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Failed to install the modules and their dependencies. Exit code: " + exit);
050        }
051        System.out.println("✅ Modules and their dependencies installed (refreshed local repo).");
052    }
053
054    static List<String> installModulesAndDependenciesCommand(List<String> modules) {
055        return Arrays.asList(
056                "mvn", "-q", "-U", "install",
057                "-DskipTests",
058                "-pl", String.join(",", modules),
059                "-am",
060                "-Dmaven.repo.local=" + System.getProperty("user.home") + "/.m2/repository"
061        );
062    }
063
064    public static void buildAndCollect(Path moduleDir, String profile, String glob, Path destDir)
065            throws IOException, InterruptedException {
066
067        String localRepo = System.getProperty("user.home") + "/.m2/repository";
068
069        List<String> cmd = new ArrayList<>();
070        cmd.addAll(Arrays.asList("mvn", "-U", "-q", "clean", "package"));
071        if (profile != null && !profile.trim().isEmpty()) {
072            cmd.add(profile.trim());
073        }
074        cmd.addAll(Arrays.asList(
075                "-Dmaven.repo.local=" + localRepo,
076                "-Dmaven.artifact.threads=1"
077        ));
078
079        System.out.println("🔧 Running: " + String.join(" ", cmd) + " (in " + moduleDir.getFileName() + ")");
080        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
081        pb.directory(moduleDir.toFile());
082        Process process = ProcessRunner.startAndFilterOutput(pb, moduleDir.getFileName().toString());
083        int exit = process.waitFor();
084        if (exit != 0) {
085            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Build failed for " + moduleDir.getFileName() + " (" + profile + ")");
086        }
087
088        FileOps.copyMatchingFiles(moduleDir.resolve("target"), glob, destDir);
089        Thread.sleep(2000);
090    }
091
092    @SuppressWarnings("SameParameterValue")
093    public static void buildAndCollectMacApp(Path moduleDir, String profile, Path destDir)
094            throws IOException, InterruptedException {
095
096        String localRepo = System.getProperty("user.home") + "/.m2/repository";
097        List<String> cmd = Arrays.asList(
098                "mvn", "-U", "-q", "clean", "package",
099                profile,
100                "-Dmaven.repo.local=" + localRepo,
101                "-Dmaven.artifact.threads=1"
102        );
103
104        System.out.println("🔧 Running: " + String.join(" ", cmd) + " (in " + moduleDir.getFileName() + ")");
105        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
106        pb.directory(moduleDir.toFile());
107        Process process = ProcessRunner.startAndFilterOutput(pb, moduleDir.getFileName().toString());
108        int exit = process.waitFor();
109        if (exit != 0) {
110            throw new RuntimeException("❌ macOS build failed for " + moduleDir.getFileName());
111        }
112
113        try (DirectoryStream<Path> stream = Files.newDirectoryStream(moduleDir.resolve("target"), "*.app")) {
114            for (Path appBundle : stream) {
115                Path dest = destDir.resolve(appBundle.getFileName());
116                System.out.println("📦 Copying " + appBundle.getFileName() + " → " + destDir);
117                FileOps.copyDirectory(appBundle, dest);
118                System.out.println("✅ Copied .app bundle");
119            }
120        }
121        Thread.sleep(2000);
122    }

124    public static void installParentPomAsRelease(String releaseVersion) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
125        Path parentPom = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("pom.xml");
126        if (!Files.exists(parentPom)) {
127            System.out.println("⚠️  Parent POM not found — skipping release install.");
128            return;
129        }
130
131        System.out.println("\n🧩 Installing parent POM as release " + releaseVersion + "...");
132        Path tmpPom = Files.createTempFile("parent-release-", ".xml");
133        Files.copy(parentPom, tmpPom, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
134
135        String content = new String(Files.readAllBytes(tmpPom), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
136                .replaceAll("<version>.*?</version>", "<version>" + releaseVersion + "</version>");
137        Files.write(tmpPom, content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
138
139        List<String> cmd = Arrays.asList(
140                "mvn", "-q", "install:install-file",
141                "-Dfile=" + tmpPom.toAbsolutePath(),
142                "-DgroupId=com.github.jjabakker",
143                "-DartifactId=paint-parent",
144                "-Dversion=" + releaseVersion,
145                "-Dpackaging=pom"
146        );
147
148        System.out.println("🔧 Running: " + String.join(" ", cmd));
149
150        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
151        pb.directory(PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.toFile());
152        pb.inheritIO();
153        ProcessRunner.enforceJava21(pb);
154        Process process = pb.start();
155        int exit = process.waitFor();
156
157        Files.deleteIfExists(tmpPom);
158
159        Path localPom = Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"),
160                                  ".m2", "repository", "com", "github", "jjabakker", "paint-parent", releaseVersion,
161                                  "paint-parent-" + releaseVersion + ".pom");
162
163        if (exit == 0 && Files.exists(localPom)) {
164            System.out.println("✅ Installed paint-parent " + releaseVersion + " locally at:");
165            System.out.println("   " + localPom.toAbsolutePath());
166        } else {
167            System.err.println("❌ Failed to install parent POM release version " + releaseVersion);
168            if (!Files.exists(localPom)) {
169                System.err.println("   ⚠️  No POM found at expected path: " + localPom.toAbsolutePath());
170            }
171            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to install paint-parent release version " + releaseVersion);
172        }
173    }

175    /**
176     * Builds one of the old installer modules. They are only in the build with the
177     * old-installers profile.
178     */
179    public static void runMavenModule(String module, String version) throws Exception {
180        List<String> cmd = Arrays.asList(
181                "mvn", "-q", "-U", "clean", "package",
182                "-Pold-installers",
183                "-pl", module, "-am",
184                "-DskipTests",
185                "-Dproject.version=" + version
186        );
187        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
188        pb.directory(PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.toFile());
189        pb.inheritIO();
190        if (pb.start().waitFor() != 0) {
191            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Maven build failed for module: " + module);
192        }
193    }
194
195    public static void alignAllPomVersions(String newVersion) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
196        System.out.println("🔄 Aligning all POM versions to " + newVersion + " using Maven Versions Plugin...");
197
198        Path projectRoot = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.toAbsolutePath();
199
200        runMaven(versionsSetCommand(newVersion, true), projectRoot, "versions:set");
201
202        runMaven(Arrays.asList(
203                "mvn", "-q", "-B", "-N", "install", "-DskipTests"
204        ), PathsConfig.BASE_PATH, "install paint-parent");
205
206        runMaven(Arrays.asList(
207                "mvn", "-q", "-B", "-N", "install:install-file",
208                "-Dfile=paint-installer/pom.xml",
209                "-DgroupId=com.github.jjabakker",
210                "-DartifactId=paint-installer",
211                "-Dversion=" + newVersion,
212                "-Dpackaging=pom"
213        ), PathsConfig.BASE_PATH, "install paint-installer");
214
215        runMaven(Arrays.asList(
216                "mvn", "-q", "-B", "versions:update-child-modules",
217                VERSION_PROFILES,
218                "-DforceVersion=true",
219                "-DgenerateBackupPoms=false",
220                "-DprocessAllModules=true"
221        ), projectRoot, "versions:update-child-modules");
222
223        System.out.println("✅ All modules (including nested) now aligned to version " + newVersion);
224    }
225
226    /**
227     * The Maven command that sets the project version. With {@code allModules} false only the
228     * parent POM gets the new version (and the modules' references to it).
229     */
230    public static List<String> versionsSetCommand(String newVersion, boolean allModules) {
231        return Arrays.asList(
232                "mvn", "-q", "-B", "versions:set",
233                VERSION_PROFILES,
234                "-DnewVersion=" + newVersion,
235                "-DgenerateBackupPoms=false",
236                "-DprocessAllModules=" + allModules
237        );
238    }
239
240    /**
241     * Builds the installers (module packaging: the macOS .pkg and the Windows setup.exe) and
242     * copies them into {@code destDir}. Both are asked for by their exact name, so a missing or
243     * stale installer stops the release.
244     */
245    public static void buildInstallers(String version, Path destDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
246        runMaven(installersCommand(), PathsConfig.BASE_PATH, "installers");
247
248        Path dist = PathsConfig.BASE_PATH.resolve("packaging/target/dist");
249        for (String name : installerNames(version)) {
250            Path built = FileOps.requireArtifact(dist, name);
251            Files.copy(built, destDir.resolve(name), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
252            System.out.println("✅ " + name + " → " + destDir);
253        }
254    }
255
256    static List<String> installersCommand() {
257        return Arrays.asList(
258                "mvn", "-q", "-B", "package",
259                "-Ppackaging",
260                "-pl", "packaging", "-am",
261                "-DskipTests"
262        );
263    }
264
265    static List<String> installerNames(String version) {
266        return Arrays.asList(
267                "Glyco-PAINT-" + version + "-macos.pkg",
268                "Glyco-PAINT-" + version + "-windows-setup.exe"
269        );
270    }
271
272    /**
273     * Stops before anything is changed if makensis (needed for the Windows installer) is not
274     * installed. Looks where packaging/pom.xml looks: the Homebrew folders and the PATH.
275     */
276    public static void requireMakensis() {
277        if (findMakensis(System.getenv("PATH")) == null) {
278            throw new IllegalStateException("makensis (needed for the Windows installer) was not found. "
279                                                     + "Install it with: brew install makensis");
280        }
281    }
282
283    static Path findMakensis(String pathVariable) {
284        List<Path> candidates = new ArrayList<>(List.of(
285                Path.of("/opt/homebrew/bin/makensis"),
286                Path.of("/usr/local/bin/makensis")));
287        if (pathVariable != null) {
288            for (String dir : pathVariable.split(java.io.File.pathSeparator)) {
289                if (!dir.isBlank()) {
290                    candidates.add(Path.of(dir, "makensis"));
291                }
292            }
293        }
294        for (Path candidate : candidates) {
295            if (Files.isExecutable(candidate)) {
296                return candidate;
297            }
298        }
299        return null;
300    }
301
302    public static void runMaven(List<String> cmd, Path dir, String label) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
303        System.out.println("🔧 Running (" + label + "): " + String.join(" ", cmd));
304        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
305        pb.directory(dir.toFile());
306        pb.inheritIO();
307        if (pb.start().waitFor() != 0) {
308            throw new RuntimeException("❌ Maven command failed: " + label);
309        }
310    }
311}
